senses.gloss:
अर्द् अर्द्, i. 1, Par.
 1. † To go.
 2. To beg, Ragh. 5, 17.
 --i. 1 and 10, Par. and Ātm.
 1. To kill, Rām. 1, 16, 30.
 2. To hurt; to wound, Pañc. 221, 13.
 3. To afflict; to vex, Rām. 3, 14, 11; 53, 27.
 --With the prep. अति अति. To press violently, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 115.
 --With अभि अभि. To press; to afflict, Rām. 2, 21, 55; cf. अभ्यर्ण्ण.
 --With प्रति प्रति. To press in return, Rām. 6, 92, 52.
 --With वि वि. To press.
 अ-व्यर्ण्ण. Not pressed, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 19.
 --With सम् सम्. To wound, MBh. 3, 761.
 --Cf. perhaps ἀρδ in ἄρδις.

ऽअर्दन -अर्द् + अन, adj. Killing, Rām. 1, 54, 17.
 कैटभ- and जन-, m. Names of Viṣṇu, Bhāg. P. 3, 24, 18; Bhartṛ. 3, 84.

आर्द्र आर्द्र, adj., f. रा.
 1. Wet, Megh. 87.
 2. Fresh, Amar. 2.
 3. Mild, Pañc. 8, 19.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. probably ἄρδω (although beginning with Ϝ, Ϝαρδ, Ϝραδ), ῥαίνω, ῥαθάμιγξ.
आर्द्रय आर्द्रय, a denomin. derived from the last, Par. To moisten, Bhartṛ. Suppl. 7.
